newsitem.title: USA: Interpublic's Lowe to acquire N.Y. agency.
newsitem.headline: Interpublic's Lowe to acquire N.Y. agency.

text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc said its Lowe & Partners/SMS unit signed a letter of intent to acquire New York advertising agency Goldsmith/Jeffrey.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Interpublic said the agency, which will operate under Lowe's name, had $50 million in billings last year, with a list of clients that includes Electronic Data Systems, the QVC network, J.P. Morgan, Knoll International, Everlast Activewear and Bergdorf Goodman.

Goldsmith/Jeffrey founders, Gary Goldmsmith and Bob Jeffrey, will join Lowe in senior positions. Goldsmith will become executive vice president and deputy creative director of Lowe/SMX and Jeffrey is to become an executive vice president.
Lowe & Partners is part of Interpublic's Lowe Group, which has $3 billion in billings and offices in 31 countries. --New York Newsdesk 212 859 1610
